description: This file defines a PHP class `HolidaySearchFilterParams` within the `OrangeHRM\-Leave\-Dto` namespace. The class extends `DateRangeSearchFilterParams` and manages search filter parameters for holidays, including a boolean flag to exclude recurring holidays and specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: HolidaySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) for holiday search filters, extending date range filtering capabilities and adding a specific flag to exclude recurring holidays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter by setting the default sort field to 'holiday.date'.

methods.name: isExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is set to exclude recurring holidays.

methods.name: setExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude recurring holidays from the filter.
